berlin_identified.role: known material: both mates match this sample's own identified contigs. The comparison arm, and where every mode's direction is measured

berlin_residue.role: the residue: neither mate matches SILVA or any own contig. The pile the production tool is trying to shrink

candidate.role: the blind: the genome results/holdout_run/ measured at read level, 30.3% nucleotide divergent, with its real reads

candidate_sim.role: the same genome sampled uniformly, which is what a simulated-pair experiment would have measured

leak.role: known material: real reads of a sequence 0.08% divergent from a pre-cutoff relative. The comparison arm every rate is read against

rung17_sim.role: a nearer blind, uniform sampling, where single-mate recognition is partly alive and a joint rule has room to show a gain
